answer: To create a fake identity, the attacker must purchase a unique, registered ferrous anchor (e.g., a certified historical gate) for $100 and wait 10 days. Each subsequent identity requires a new anchor. Renting a counterfeit anchor risks $5000 fine. The anchor must be genuinely scarce and non-duplicable, as one real-world asset backs exactly ONE identity, duplicates are rejected on check. Creating a fake terrace anchor on a ferrous trellis costs an additional $50 and 5 days per identity. To create 100 fake identities costs $10,000 and 1000 days.
